**Finding: Compliant** — no redline required.

The document already delivers our preferred IP position:

- **Deliverables (§14.2):** Customer owns each Deliverable on creation, with an express present assignment from Vendor, flow-down assignments from Vendor personnel, and further-assurance cooperation.
- **Vendor IP (§14.3 + §13.2):** Vendor retains only Vendor Technology (acceptable), and any Vendor Technology embedded in or needed to use a Deliverable is covered by a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works for our business — plus pre-delivery identification duties and a bar on restrictive third-party material without our approval.
- **Customer Data (§14.1, §15.1, §1.3):** We own all Customer Data (including derived output), Vendor gets only a limited processing right, and there is no sale, advertising use, commingling or model training without our consent.
- **No joint ownership (§14.4):** Expressly excluded absent a separate signed instrument setting exploitation rights; feedback is voluntary and we retain unrestricted rights in our own feedback.

No assignment of our IP or data to Silverline, and no vendor-owned deliverables without a licence back, so nothing to flag.
